---
title: "BAG3 Fractionated Proteomics Analysis"
description: "Reproducible Quarto and R analysis supporting a fractionated human skeletal-muscle proteomics study."
---

This public analysis project accompanies the 2026 *Nature Communications* study, “Fractionated proteomics identifies a protein network mitigating resistance exercise-induced damage in human skeletal muscle.”

The study combines fractionation of human skeletal-muscle samples with proteomics and phosphoproteomics to examine adaptation to resistance exercise and identify proteins associated with the sarcomeric response. The analysis repository documents the BAG3-TurboID proteomics workflow used for missing-value imputation and differential-abundance analysis.

## Reproducibility Highlights

- Quarto notebook combining narrative, code, and results.
- R code for a two-step missing-value imputation strategy.
- Differential-abundance analysis of BAG3 proximity-biotinylation proteomics data.
- Direct connection between the published study and its computational workflow.
